title: Dance class with friends
text: Amazing experience, Mercedes made us all feel comfortable learning the dance. Such a laugh. Thank you
author: jaynecU835LA

title: Sevillanas Flamenco Dance Class
text: As a birthday surprise, I treated my friends to a flamenco lesson with Mercedes (Sevillanas in Sitges) they had a blast.  Mercedes was clear in her instructions, & guided the girls step-by-step & by the end of the session the girls had learned a basic flamenco dance.  Highly recommend, lots of fun & laughs!
author: Lourdes_R

title: Amazing experience
text:
Amazing and funny experience 
No pressure during the course so we enjoyed looking miserable and we leaned a lot  about the Sevilla’s legendary Flamingo
author: 513wassimm

title: Highlight of our Spain trip
text: The Flamenco Experience was the highlight of our time in Barcelona. Mercedes dressed us in authentic, handmade dresses that she designed. She styled our hair, taught the dance steps and held a photo shot on her delightful patio.
author: yhall_go

title: Flamenco dancing lesson.
text: Great experience if you want an introduction to Flamenco dancing and culture. There is a beautiful array of flamenco dresses and accessories in the shop. The lovely teacher even managed to teach us a few moves too! Would highly recommended.
author: Eve M

title: Tailred and private flamenco class
text: Great experience and value for money, we booked at short notice the night before and got to enjoy a lesson just my partner and I. I chose to hire the shoes which I'm sure added to the experience and was a nominal price. We learned a lot of steps and got a full routine in two difference dances. Would definitely recommend for those brave enough to try something new.
author: Shannon_M

title: authentic and exciting experience!
text:
I visited Mercedes' atelier with a school class (16-18 years old - boys and girls). I was very excited and a bit nervous prior to the visit - how would the group respond to the experience? Answer: they loved it! They participated with interest and passion and the teacher (was her name Elena?) did an excellent job and was patient when we as Danes proved that we do not have the same sense of rythm as the Spanish people :-). 
If I go on a study trip to Barcelona again, I will definitely return to MercedesMestre for flamenco dance lessons. It is an authentic and interesting - and FUN experience.
author: paulsenlise

title: Great Fun
text: My wife and I did this experience with my daughter and her boyfriend. We all had a blast. The people are super friendly and it’s a really great addition to your Barcelona visit, highly recommend it!
